entries.title: Resolve Recipients supplied-snapshot adaptation
uses: Disambiguate people and bound recipient groups before an authorized message, invitation, or meeting action. Use for ambiguous names, cross-platform identities, or requests such as everyone on a project; this skill resolves identities and does not send.
